issue_request: FHIR-39803 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for StructureDefinition, raised in R5 and applied for R5, asking that the StructureDefinition.baseDefinition comment accommodate the new Base type by updating the sentence that previously allowed only Element or another logical model.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-39803 was found. Commit a989c6c323688dc4dab6f15504f5ab38c1d05f56, whose subject cites FHIR-39806, made the same source change by adding Base to the StructureDefinition.baseDefinition comment.
additional_context: FHIR-39802, FHIR-39804, FHIR-39805, and FHIR-39806 are the same request family. FHIR-39802 says the change was already dealt with under another task, and FHIR-39804/FHIR-39805/FHIR-39806 already have reconciliation commits on the combined branch. A contemporaneous Zulip logical-model discussion supports the R5 understanding that Base is a valid first logical-model base; direct FHIR-39803 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/fhir.ini actively includes StructureDefinition and source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml already says logical models have a base of "Base", "Element" or another logical model.
